title: Slack Tide Sportfishing
specs: Fishing locations include Pacific Coastline, Inner Banks, Outer Banks (Big Bank), Barkley Sound, and Broken Group Islands
Boat is a 26 Hourston Glascraft with heated cabin, seating for 5 adults, and top safety gear
TIDAL WATERS fishing licence with SALMON TAG required for all guests including children under 16
No fishing experience required; instruction provided
includes: Fish cleaning and bagging for transport
Fish processing and packaging included in 3 day package
blurb: Guests join guided fishing charters to fish for salmon, halibut, and crab off the coast of Vancouver Island. Trips range from 4 to 8 hours or multi-day packages, with options for custom tours focusing on wildlife and scenery. The boat has a heated cabin and all necessary fishing and safety gear is provided.
extraNote: Prices are per 2 people with additional person fees; max 5 people per trip · Meet 2 minutes before departure for safety briefing and trip introduction · Fishing licences must be carried and printed if purchased online · Small Craft Harbours, 200 Hemlock Street, Ucluelet, BC, at the dock finger # (far left corner of the parking lot) · May through September peak season in Ucluelet; November through May winter season in Comox Valley
